headline: President Obama created an advisory council to give him outside advice on job creation and US economic competitiveness.
what_it_does: This executive order set up the President's Council on Jobs and Competitiveness. Based on the title, the council's role was to advise the President on ways to create jobs and help the US economy compete. No summary was provided, so details about its members, powers, and duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: People appointed to the council would serve as advisors to the President on jobs and competitiveness.
They would receive advice from the council on economic and job-related issues.
